note: Town of Bell campground on the north shore of Siskiwit Lake, an inland lake about 4.5 miles south of Cornucopia. Numbered wooded sites around a common area with a solar water pump; no camping on the beach. --Claude
summary: Town of Bell rules page read: $30 hard-sided ($20 tent), cash/check on arrival, 26-ft limit for hard-sided campers, FCFS only, 14-day limit (extensions by permission). No site count, toilets, season or electric published. Not waterfront kept (sites in woods behind a shore tree band). Pin ~65 m from Google's point; fine. Google 4.5/10.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. No site numbers or layout are published. On Esri z19/NAIP the campground is a short spur off Siskiwit Shores Dr to a sandy open common area (about 46.7990,-91.1297) with wooded sites around it; a continuous tree band (~25 m) separates the open ground from the shore, and no pad shows on open ground within ~50 m of the water. Not a coastal walk: Siskiwit Lake is inland and the Lake Superior shore at Cornucopia is ~7 km away.

UNKNOWN: site count, toilets, season and the water's potability are not published (the town says only 'A solar water pump is in the common area'). Stored facilities.potable_water true is left as it was but rests on that line alone; the reviewer may clear it.
